name: 86 Chaos 16.0.55 Temporary Release-Gate Test Accounts Fix
label: 86 Chaos 16.0.55 Temporary Release-Gate Test Accounts Fix
notes: Adds testing-only release-gate temporary account provisioning so the harness can create distinct System Administrator, owner, manager, and staff QA accounts without committing credentials to source.
releaseNotes: Release-gate runners can now provision dedicated testing-only Firebase Auth accounts before role verification when CHAOS_QA_AUTO_PROVISION_TEST_USERS=true.

The provisioner creates or refreshes four distinct QA accounts, sets the System Administrator claim only on the system account, clears admin claims from owner/manager/staff test accounts, and writes safe Firestore test profiles.
Provisioning refuses to use geoffm1985@gmail.com or any non-QA-looking email unless an explicit testing-only override is set.
The generated reports never include passwords, ID tokens, refresh tokens, API keys, or service-account values.
No runtime app behavior, design, Firebase rules, Firebase indexes, or production data is changed by this testing-harness fix.
releaseTitle: 86 Chaos 16.0.55 Temporary Release-Gate Test Accounts Fix
